Lucas Museum of Narrative Art Opens After 16 Years and $1 Billion

The Lucas Museum of Narrative Art has opened after a 16-year process that spanned three cities and cost $1 billion. The museum, founded by George Lucas, is dedicated to narrative art. Initial coverage highlights its extensive timeline and significant financial investment.
